ayahOccurrences.text: فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 2nd person masculine plural (form IV) imperfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: تُمْسُونَ is in the derivative form: تُمْسِى
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
م/س/و-ي   m–s–w/y evening, to enter the evening time; to clear the uterus of a she‐camel by hand; to help someone; hardship; middle of the road. Of these 2 roots, only تُمْسُون tumsūn occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
تُمْسِى tumsı [imperf. of v. IV أمْسَى ʾamsā, intrans.] to enter into evening

(30:17) فَسُبْحَانَ‏ ‏اللَّهِ‏ ‏حِينَ‏ ‏تُمْسُونَ‏ ‏وَحِينَ‏ ‏تُصْبِحُونَ‏ celebrate God’s glory when you enter into the evening and rise in the morning (i.e., continuously).
